about: Reviewed git tree id per skill folder (plan 9.3). Bundled: default on/off in every account. Optional: offered in Settings (off until the person enables it) or not offered. A skill tree that changes upstream fails make hermes-sync-check until its entry is re-recorded; a skill with no entry is left out of the seed tree and stays off.
basis: line-by-line, phase 3 (2026-11-11): every bundled SKILL.md was read in full and every offered optional skill's description; table and reasons in docs/plans/2026-11-11-phase3-skills-review.md. A bundled skill is on by default only when its core job works in a phase 3 chat (Timely tools, todo, skills, memory, past-chat search, web) and it points the agent at nothing Timely refuses (Hermes itself, ~/.hermes, messaging, kanban, the host's own logins); skills whose core job needs terminal, file or browser tools are off until phase 5 re-reviews them. Denied skills (policy/skills-denied.json) are off and never seeded; denied optional skills are never offered. A person can still turn on any reviewed, not-denied skill in Settings.
